lore.text: In ancient Egypt, Prince Khufu and Princess Chay-Ara were killed by sorcerer Hath-Set with a dagger made of rare Nth Metal. The Nth Metal caused Khufu and Chay-Ara to be continuously reincarnated, along with Hath-Set, who sought their death. During World War II, their incarnations were archaeologists Carter Hall and Shiera Sanders, with Hath-Set returning as Anton Hastor. Remembering his past, Hastor kidnapped Shiera before she regained her memories, planning to use her to lure Carter and kill them both. But Carter regained his memories by touching Nth Metal and crafted a set of wings using its antigravity properties. He freed Shiera and gave her a similar costume after restoring her memories. As Hawkman and Hawkgirl, they fought Hastor, criminals, and Nazis in the Golden Age of heroes.

Carter and Shiera had a long and distinguished career as members of the Justice Society of America and Justice League, bridging different eras and generations of heroes. They learned that the Nth Metal that gave their wings antigravity properties had come from a crashed spaceship from the planet Thanagar, whose people used it in similar ways; it was buried memories from Khufu seeing the ship's mortally wounded pilot that inspired their costumes. They had a son, Hector, who was tragically killed by Hath-Set, although he proved to have inherited his parents' tendency toward reincarnation and has returned in a different life. Carter and Shiera died in action during the Zero Hour incident. However, it was inevitable that they would return.

Kendra Saunders, a young woman living in Texas, was the granddaughter of World War II-era adventurer Speed Saunders. Emotionally troubled, she tried to kill herself. Afterward, her eyes changed color, and due to this and other reasons, her grandfather realized the soul of his late cousin, Shiera Sanders, the Golden Age Hawkgirl, had entered Kendra's body. Mentored by Speed and inner impulses she didn't understand, Kendra trained as Hawkgirl, using the original Hawkgirl's equipment and weapons. She joined the Justice Society of America, aware of the previous Hawkgirl's history with the team but not yet aware of her own connection.

The Justice Society of America (JSA) had an adventure on the planet Thanagar, from where the Nth Metal that empowered Hawkman and Hawkgirl had come. While there, Thanagarian priests used Kendra's Nth Metal and connection to the soul of Carter Hall to resurrect Hawkman, wanting him to be their champion against the evil Onimar Synn. Carter defeated Synn and returned to Earth with the JSA. The dynamic between Carter and Kendra was tense because, while he immediately recognized her as the new incarnation of his love Shiera, she had none of those memories and wanted to be her own person. Hawkman understood, and while they worked together as teammates, there was no romance between them. Wanting to blaze her own trail, Hawkgirl joined the Justice League and dated Red Arrow (Roy Harper), but it didn't last.

During the war against the Black Lanterns, both Hawkman and Hawkgirl were killed and resurrected. For a time, Hawkgirl was Shiera Sanders again, during which she killed the latest incarnation of Hath-Set. However, during the Flashpoint timeline reset, Hawkgirl reverted to being Kendra. She joined the modern-day incarnation of the Blackhawks, who were dedicated to preventing the end of the world. During one adventure, the Nth Metal was bonded with her physical body, endowing her with actual wings composed of Nth Metal and giving her additional physical enhancements.

Hawkgirl has become a key member of the Justice League, with her leadership and strategic skills recognized and valued. On a mission to Thanagar Prime with Martian Manhunter and Green Lantern John Stewart, Hawkgirl met Shayera Hol, the Empress of Thanagar, who revealed she was Kendra's previous incarnation, but interference in the timeline by cosmic beings resulted in them existing at the same time as separate people. Hawkgirl continues to research the amazing properties of the Nth Metal while serving with the Justice League.

guide.overview: A powerful **physical Guardian**, Hawkgirl fights by **absorbing spiritual damage with her [Nth Metal Aegis]** while **dealing physical AoE damage**. When paired with [Birds of Prey] or [Justice League] allies, she can further increase her Max HP.

legacyPieces.name: Thanagarian Mace
legacyPieces.reason: Hawkgirl's signature gear. Increases Spiritual Defense, permanently raises her Attack when she's hit by enemy basic attacks, and boosts her physical damage. At the start of battle, grants all allies [Nth Metal Aegis].

legacyPieces.name: Gabriel Horn
legacyPieces.reason: Hawkgirl needs to stay on the front line and keep up the pressure, and this weapon helps improve the entire squad's combat effectiveness.

legacyPieces.name: Not-So-Huge Hammer
legacyPieces.reason: Hawkgirl's [Nth Metal Aegis] scales with her Max HP, so this weapon improves how much damage the Aegis can absorb.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: Hawkgirl relies on high Max HP to strengthen her [Nth Metal Aegis], and this weapon's base stats fit her core playstyle well.
